timer_plan.reset_conditions: Not applicable; no timing requirement is specified.

priorities: Forward and reverse outputs are mutually exclusive. Opposing manual requests produce neither direction.
In automatic mode, destination arrival transitions out of the corresponding MOVE state and stops the motor in the same scan; a station button cannot advance the next phase until a later scan.
Manual mode overrides automatic sequencing and resets phase to WAIT_A on every manual scan. Manual outputs follow button levels immediately.
Automatic transitions use the pre-scan phase and sampled inputs; accept at most one phase transition per scan. Station buttons are level-sensitive and accepted only in their corresponding wait state.
On return to automatic, start from WAIT_A; if SensorA and ButtonA are already true, their transition may occur in that scan.
The specified interface has no emergency-stop input or safety-rated functions. Provide appropriate independent safety circuitry and contactor interlocking in the physical installation.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample all input levels at invocation. No edge detection is required; do not edge-gate the level-sensitive buttons.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: If Mode is false, set phase to WAIT_A. Otherwise evaluate exactly one transition from the pre-scan phase using the sampled inputs. Arrival and completion-removal transitions take effect in this scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FB calls are required. If timers are added later, call each once per scan unconditionally at top level.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign outputs once using sampled inputs and the post-transition phase.

assignments.MotorForward: (NOT Mode AND ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton) OR (Mode AND (phase = MOVE_AB OR phase = MOVE_BC))
assignments.MotorReverse: NOT Mode AND ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton
